question: What is the direction of expression-consistency association after transforming recovered raw Compass penalties correctly?
decision: Replace the mistaken sign interpretation, conditional on full reproduction of stored v2 summaries from the recovered v1 cache.
strongest_rival: The recovered cache may not support the stored v2 pool labels or reaction statistics; an input or version mismatch could invalidate correction.
discriminator: Fail unless every numeric column for all 83 nonconstant reactions matches v2 within rtol 1e-9 and atol 1e-12; then verify rho sign reversal and unchanged nominal p values for all six scores.
exposure_record: Fully exposed: prior v1/v2 summaries and orientation warning were read. A preliminary audit checked PGM/PGCD sign reversal and equality of saved v1/v2 tables before freezing. This correction is not independent validation or a new solver run.
biological_unit: Micropool of about 50 Th17n cells, nested in library (4 Th17n libraries) and animal (2). The pool is a computational construct, not a biological replicate.
nesting_and_overlap: Pools are disjoint sets of cells from a single library, so pools within a library share the animal and the culture. Correlations across pools therefore describe within-deposit variation and are not replicated observations.
population_and_selection: Wp-R1's QC-passing Th17n cells (8,711). Pools with at least 20 cells are eligible; a stratified subsample of 60 eligible pools, equal share per library, seed 20261004, is scored because each pool costs about a minute of solver time.
contrast: Across pools: each reaction's Compass score against the pool mean pathogenicity score, and against the pro-inflammatory arm, the pro-regulatory arm, the Table S3 Th17n EGCG signature and a proliferation score.
endpoint: All six pool-score Spearman associations, nominal p values and pathogenicity BH across the same 83 nonconstant reactions, with corrected consistency scale and named reaction ranks.
methods: Use hash-bound v1 raw penalty cache and v2 pool scores. Verify all 83 saved reaction summaries including means, standard deviations, six correlations and their nominal p values, and BH. Transform consistency=-log1p(penalty). Recompute the same reaction universe and BH family; rank ascending signed rho explicitly. Report transformed means and SDs separately from raw penalty means and SDs.
missingness_and_exclusions: Reactions with zero variance across pools are dropped and the count reported. Pools below 20 cells are ineligible. If Compass fails, the run records status compass_failed and no correlation.
multiplicity: BH across reactions for the pathogenicity endpoint; other score endpoints are reported unadjusted as descriptive.
precision_basis: Pools within a library are not independent of each other, so the nominal degrees of freedom of a 60-pool correlation overstate the information; no confidence statement is made.
interpretation_limit: Descriptive exposed version/input sensitivity, not published Figure 1 reproduction. Recovered v1 cache is accepted only through full v2 summary verification; original v2 solver file is not recovered. Four libraries and two animals; pool p values are not animal-level inference. Corrected positive PGAM association would not reproduce the published negative sign and does not refute intervention evidence or establish flux.
stop_rule: Stop on any nonfinite/negative penalty, duplicate identity, differing pool/reaction set or failed cache verification. Do not invoke the solver or alter pools, reaction scope or endpoints.
amendment_reason: v1/v2 treated reactions.tsv raw penalties as already negative-log transformed. Correct scale and direction; preserve historical artifacts. Reuse recovered cache only after exhaustive agreement with saved v2 summaries.
